# Requirements Quality Checklist: P-RF05 — Personal summary export

**Purpose**: Broad requirements-quality review of spec.md ahead of `/speckit-tasks`/`/speckit-implement` — completeness, clarity, consistency, measurability, scenario/edge-case coverage, non-functional coverage, and assumption validity. Grounded against `docs/input/backend/export-screen-states.md`, `docs/input/backend/error-taxonomy.md`, and this unit's own `plan.md`/`data-model.md` where they reveal gaps in spec.md itself.
**Created**: 2026-10-24
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Is the client's behavior specified when `GET /export/{jobId}/status` itself fails (timeout/offline) mid-poll, as opposed to only covering what happens once the job reaches a terminal state? [Gap, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK002 Is a bound defined on how long or how many times the sheet keeps polling a status endpoint that keeps failing, before it must settle into a visible state rather than polling indefinitely? [Gap, Spec §SC-005]
- [ ] CHK003 Is the sheet's behavior specified when "Fechar" is tapped while a PDF or raw-data download is already in flight (as opposed to while the job itself is still "Pendente"/"Processando")? [Gap, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK004 Is a requirement defined for what the sheet shows if the file-share step succeeds in fetching the file but the OS share sheet is dismissed without the user saving/sending it anywhere? [Gap, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK005 Are requirements defined for an export whose period is large enough to trigger a payload-size failure (`PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE`), or is this outcome left entirely unaddressed by spec.md? [Gap, Non-Functional]
- [ ] CHK006 Are requirements defined for initiating, polling, or downloading an export while the device itself is offline, distinct from the mid-session-expiry handling FR-012 already covers? [Gap, Non-Functional]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK007 Is "frequent enough that the user does not perceive the sheet as stuck" (Assumptions §"Status polling") quantified with any concrete bound, or left fully open to interpretation? [Clarity, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK008 Is "the system's normal response time" in SC-005 defined anywhere in spec.md, or does it depend on an external, unstated baseline? [Clarity, Measurability, Spec §SC-005]
- [ ] CHK009 Is "visually and functionally distinct" (FR-007's requirement that the full-failure state differ from FR-006's narrative-only state) defined with concrete, checkable attributes rather than left to subjective judgment? [Clarity, Measurability, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK010 Is "retryable state" (Edge Cases — a failed PDF/raw download) defined precisely enough to distinguish it from the sheet's two non-retryable terminal failure states ("Erro"/FR-007's state), which offer no retry control at all? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK011 Does FR-010's enumerated list of states requiring a functional "Fechar" link ("Pendente", "Processando", "Concluído", "Erro", "Período vazio" — five) include FR-007's separately-asserted sixth generic-failure state, or does FR-010's own five-item enumeration conflict with FR-007's claim that "Fechar" is available there too? [Conflict, Spec §FR-007 vs §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK012 Does SC-004's "from any of its five states" match the six-state model the resolved Clarification and FR-007 establish, or does SC-004's count conflict with FR-007's own state? [Conflict, Spec §SC-004 vs §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK013 Do FR-004 ("Pendente" → "Processando") and the Assumptions' statement that the backend's intermediate "data ready, narrative still generating" status is "still part of Processando" agree on exactly one required visual treatment for every status that maps to "Processando"? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004 vs §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK014 Is the Assumption that the status-poll interval "is an implementation detail, not a product requirement" reconcilable with SC-005's requirement that every attempt reach a terminal state "within the system's normal response time" — can SC-005 be verified at all if the polling cadence is unconstrained? [Conflict, Spec §Assumptions vs §SC-005]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK015 Can SC-001's "zero crashes and zero empty or malformed files, across all tested periods" be objectively verified without spec.md defining what range/sample of periods constitutes "all tested periods"? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK016 Is SC-002's "clear explanation of what happened" measurable against any criterion, or does it restate FR-006's requirement without adding a testable threshold? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK017 Does SC-003 add a measurable criterion beyond FR-003's own wording, or is it a non-additive restatement that could be collapsed without losing test coverage? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK018 Are requirements defined for a job that fails immediately after creation — i.e., transitions straight to the FR-007 failure state without the sheet ever visibly passing through "Processando"? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK019 Is it specified, as a requirement rather than only an Assumption aside, that reopening the export sheet for the same period after a prior export's sheet was closed always creates a fresh job rather than attaching to any job left running server-side? [Coverage, Spec §Assumptions "Resuming an export after leaving the sheet"]
- [ ] CHK020 Is a requirement defined for what the user sees in the interval between tapping the download icon and the "Pendente" state rendering, or is a gap-free transition assumed without being stated? [Coverage, Clarity, Spec §FR-004]

## Edge Case Coverage
